english: something that has been remembered
primaryExample: That familiar smell brought back a happy memory of the summer we spent by the sea.
primaryTranslation: 那熟悉的气味唤起了我们在海边度过夏天的美好回忆。

english: color of young leaves
primaryExample: We chose a soft green for the kitchen because it made the small room feel calmer.
primaryTranslation: 我们为厨房选了柔和的绿色，因为它让小房间显得更宁静。

english: some music with words in verse
primaryExample: The song reminded everyone of their school days, although none of them remembered all the words.
primaryTranslation: 这首歌让大家想起学生时代，尽管没有人记得全部歌词。

english: to disagree; to protest against an idea or plan
primaryExample: Several neighbours object to the plan because the new road would pass close to their homes.
primaryTranslation: 几位邻居反对该计划，因为新公路会紧邻他们的家。

english: to keep, exist or continue without changing
primaryExample: The volunteers maintain the garden throughout the year, so visitors can enjoy it in every season.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者全年维护花园，让游客每个季节都能欣赏它。

english: system to buy something and pay for it later
primaryExample: She bought the washing machine on credit because she could not afford the full price immediately.
primaryTranslation: 她赊购了洗衣机，因为无法立即付清全款。

english: a thing that roughly forms a circle, usually around something; the sound of a bell
primaryExample: A thin ring of light appeared around the moon as we walked home through the park.
primaryTranslation: 我们穿过公园回家时，月亮周围出现了一圈细细的光。

english: to find something new that was not known before
primaryExample: The children hope to discover how the machine works before they build a smaller version themselves.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们希望先弄清机器如何运作，再自己制作缩小版。

english: not alive
primaryExample: The tree was dead, but the gardener left its trunk standing as a home for insects.
primaryTranslation: 这棵树已经死了，但园丁留下树干供昆虫栖息。

english: time after 12:00 and before the evening meal
primaryExample: We spent the afternoon exploring the old town before returning to our hotel for dinner.
primaryTranslation: 我们整个下午都在游览老城区，随后回旅馆吃晚饭。

english: to like something better than something else
primaryExample: I prefer working near a window because natural light helps me stay focused during long tasks.
primaryTranslation: 我更喜欢在窗边工作，因为自然光有助于我长时间保持专注。

english: to straighten or stretch something out (e.g., your leg)
primaryExample: Please extend your arm slowly while the instructor checks that you are holding the racket correctly.
primaryTranslation: 请慢慢伸直手臂，让教练检查你的握拍姿势是否正确。

english: something with a chance of happening or being true
primaryExample: We discussed the possibility of travelling by train, since the airport was far from the city.
primaryTranslation: 我们讨论了乘火车旅行的可能性，因为机场离市区很远。

english: describes the way you are going (e.g., north)
primaryExample: The guide pointed in the direction of the village, which was hidden behind a wooded hill.
primaryTranslation: 向导指向村子的方向，村子藏在一座林木茂盛的小山后。

english: piece of equipment or buildings with a special use
primaryExample: The new sports facility includes an indoor pool, so local families can swim throughout the year.
primaryTranslation: 新的体育设施包括室内泳池，当地家庭全年都能游泳。

english: a particular type or types of things or persons
primaryExample: The market sells a wide variety of vegetables, including several kinds that we had never tried.
primaryTranslation: 市场出售多种蔬菜，其中有几种我们从未尝过。

english: happening every day
primaryExample: She practises daily, even when she has only fifteen minutes available before leaving for work.
primaryTranslation: 她每天都练习，即使上班前只有十五分钟空闲。

english: things you wear on your body (e.g., shirt, dress, tie)
primaryExample: We packed some warm clothes because the mountain village often becomes cold after the sun sets.
primaryTranslation: 我们带了些保暖衣物，因为山村在日落后常常变冷。

english: flat surface on a computer, or tv that shows images
primaryExample: The screen was bright enough for us to read the instructions even in the sunny room.
primaryTranslation: 即使房间阳光充足，屏幕亮度仍足以让我们看清说明。

english: to follow behind someone to see what they are doing
primaryExample: Researchers track the birds throughout the winter to learn where they find food when temperatures fall.
primaryTranslation: 研究人员整个冬天都跟踪这些鸟，了解降温时它们在哪里觅食。

english: to move your body rhythmically to music
primaryExample: The children learned to dance together, although they found it difficult to follow the music initially.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们学习一起跳舞，尽管起初很难跟上音乐。

english: in every way or as much as possible
primaryExample: The room looked completely different after we moved the furniture and painted the walls a lighter colour.
primaryTranslation: 挪动家具并将墙壁刷浅后，房间看起来完全不同了。

english: person of the sex that gives birth to babies
primaryExample: The female engineer explained her design clearly, and several students stayed afterwards to ask her questions.
primaryTranslation: 这位女工程师清楚地讲解了设计，几位学生课后留下提问。

english: state of being dependable or reliable
primaryExample: Taking responsibility for the mistake helped him regain the trust of colleagues who had felt disappointed.
primaryTranslation: 承担错误的责任，帮助他重新赢得了失望同事的信任。

english: being first made, thought, or performed; fresh
primaryExample: We compared the translation with the original text to check whether the meaning had changed.
primaryTranslation: 我们对照译文和原文，检查意思是否发生了变化。

english: female you share a parent with
primaryExample: My sister offered to collect the children because she knew our meeting might finish later than expected.
primaryTranslation: 姐姐主动提出接孩子，因为她知道我们的会议可能延迟结束。

english: big stone; hard, solid substance forming mountains
primaryExample: A large rock blocked the narrow path, so we had to find another way down the hill.
primaryTranslation: 一块巨石挡住了狭窄小路，我们只好另找下山的路。

english: images, thoughts, and feelings that are experienced during sleep
primaryExample: In my dream, I was exploring a city where every street led back to my childhood home.
primaryTranslation: 梦中我探索着一座城市，每条街都通向儿时的家。

english: used to show two things that are both untrue or do not happen
primaryExample: She neither complained about the delay nor asked for special treatment when the train finally arrived.
primaryTranslation: 火车终于到站时，她既没有抱怨延误，也没有要求特殊待遇。

english: high-level educational institution; college
primaryExample: The university offers evening classes for people who want to continue studying while working full time.
primaryTranslation: 这所大学为希望全职工作之余继续学习的人开设夜校。

english: without difficulty
primaryExample: The instructions were written clearly, so even beginners could easily understand how to use the device.
primaryTranslation: 说明写得很清楚，因此连初学者都能轻松理解设备的用法。

english: business that provides some service for others
primaryExample: The travel agency arranged a different hotel after discovering that our original booking had been cancelled.
primaryTranslation: 旅行社发现原先的预订被取消后，另给我们安排了旅馆。

english: a basic unit of money equal to 100 cent
primaryExample: He saved a dollar every day until he had enough money to buy his own dictionary.
primaryTranslation: 他每天存一美元，直到有足够的钱购买自己的词典。

english: yard; ground outside your house to grow plants
primaryExample: We planted flowers in the garden so that there would be something colourful throughout the summer.
primaryTranslation: 我们在花园里种了花，让整个夏天都有鲜艳的色彩。

english: to make something whole or able to work again
primaryExample: The mechanic offered to fix the bicycle while we waited, which saved us another journey.
primaryTranslation: 修车师傅提出在我们等候时修好自行车，省得我们再跑一趟。

english: in or toward the front
primaryExample: We could see a small village ahead, although the path towards it was hidden by trees.
primaryTranslation: 我们看见前方有个小村庄，尽管通往村庄的小路被树林遮住。

english: to meet at one point
primaryExample: The two paths cross near the bridge, where walkers usually stop to check their maps.
primaryTranslation: 两条小路在桥附近相交，徒步者通常在那里停下查看地图。

english: yes (informal)
primaryExample: When I asked whether she wanted to join our team, she smiled and said, 'Yeah, definitely.'
primaryTranslation: 我问她是否愿意加入团队时，她笑着说：“当然愿意。”

english: a person being considered for a job or position in office
primaryExample: Each candidate had to explain how they would solve a problem before the interview panel made its decision.
primaryTranslation: 面试小组决定之前，每位候选人都必须说明解决问题的方法。

english: how heavy something is
primaryExample: The weight of the bag surprised me because it contained only a few books and a laptop.
primaryTranslation: 包的重量让我吃惊，因为里面只有几本书和一台笔记本电脑。

english: concerning the law; allowed by law
primaryExample: The company sought legal advice before signing the agreement, since several conditions were difficult to understand.
primaryTranslation: 公司在签约前咨询了法律意见，因为几个条款很难理解。

english: offer or plan to people who can decide about it
primaryExample: Her proposal received strong support because it offered a practical way to reduce waste without increasing costs.
primaryTranslation: 她的提议得到大力支持，因为它能切实减少浪费而不增加成本。

english: particular form of something and other forms
primaryExample: The latest version includes a simpler menu, although users can still choose the old layout if they prefer.
primaryTranslation: 最新版本增加了更简单的菜单，用户仍可选择原来的布局。

english: when you talk with other people; discussion or chat
primaryExample: Our conversation continued long after dinner because we discovered that we shared an interest in local history.
primaryTranslation: 晚饭后我们聊了很久，因为发现彼此都对当地历史感兴趣。

english: person who is not known or named
primaryExample: Somebody had left a note on the door explaining where we should wait until the office opened.
primaryTranslation: 有人在门上留了字条，说明办公室开门前我们该在哪里等候。

english: unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kg
primaryExample: The recipe requires a pound of potatoes, but you can adjust the amount for a smaller family.
primaryTranslation: 食谱需要一磅土豆，但可以按家庭人数减少用量。

english: weekly or monthly publication with pictures and stories
primaryExample: She reads a science magazine every month because its articles explain difficult ideas in an interesting way.
primaryTranslation: 她每月读一本科学杂志，因为文章能生动解释复杂概念。

english: outer form of something, what it looks like
primaryExample: The shape of the bottle makes it easy to hold, even when your hands are wet.
primaryTranslation: 瓶子的形状方便握持，即使手湿时也一样。

english: place with a large amount of salt water
primaryExample: We could hear the sea from our bedroom, although the beach was hidden behind the houses.
primaryTranslation: 虽然海滩被房屋挡住，我们在卧室里仍能听到海浪声。

english: without any delay; straight away; right (after or before)
primaryExample: Please contact the office immediately if your address changes, so important letters do not go missing.
primaryTranslation: 地址变更时请立即联系办公室，以免重要信件遗失。

english: friendly greeting to someone who has arrived
primaryExample: The family gave us such a warm welcome that we felt comfortable almost as soon as we arrived.
primaryTranslation: 这家人热情欢迎我们，让我们几乎一到就觉得很自在。

english: to show happiness by pulling up the corners of your mouth
primaryExample: She began to smile when she realised that everyone had remembered the story she told last week.
primaryTranslation: 发现大家都记得她上周讲的故事时，她开始微笑。

english: the process or method to give or exchange information
primaryExample: Clear communication between the two teams prevented small mistakes from becoming serious problems during the project.
primaryTranslation: 两个团队清晰的沟通，防止了项目中的小错误变成大问题。

english: person who can represent and decide for others
primaryExample: Our agent checked the documents carefully before agreeing to represent us in discussions with the publisher.
primaryTranslation: 代理人仔细检查文件后，才同意代表我们与出版商洽谈。

english: involved in a tradition
primaryExample: The restaurant serves traditional dishes that local families have prepared in much the same way for generations.
primaryTranslation: 餐厅供应传统菜肴，当地家庭几代人都用相似的方法制作。

english: to use instead of something else
primaryExample: We decided to replace the old windows because too much heat was escaping during the winter.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定更换旧窗户，因为冬天从窗户散失的热量太多。

english: to form an opinion after careful consideration
primaryExample: It is difficult to judge the quality of the course until you have attended a few lessons.
primaryTranslation: 上过几节课后，你才能判断这门课程的质量。

english: female person that did the original action
primaryExample: She repaired the chair herself after watching a short video that explained which tools she needed.
primaryTranslation: 她看完工具说明短片后，自己修好了椅子。

english: in an unexpected or very quick manner
primaryExample: The lights suddenly went out while we were preparing dinner, so we finished cooking by candlelight.
primaryTranslation: 我们准备晚饭时突然停电，只好借着烛光做完。

english: people born and living at about the same time
primaryExample: Each generation brings new ideas to the family business while trying to preserve the values it inherited.
primaryTranslation: 每一代人都为家族企业带来新想法，同时努力保留传承的价值观。

english: guess or calculation of cost, size, or value
primaryExample: The builder gave us an estimate before starting, but warned that unexpected repairs might increase the cost.
primaryTranslation: 建筑工开工前提供了估价，但提醒意外维修可能增加费用。

english: most liked; best loved
primaryExample: Her favorite book is one she first read as a child, and she still returns to it occasionally.
primaryTranslation: 她最喜欢的书是儿时读过的一本，如今仍偶尔重读。

english: something that is hard to do
primaryExample: We had difficulty finding the hotel because the street names on our map were out of date.
primaryTranslation: 地图上的街名过时了，因此我们很难找到旅馆。

english: to buy something; to get by paying money for it
primaryExample: Visitors can purchase tickets online in advance, which usually saves time when the museum is busy.
primaryTranslation: 游客可以提前在线购票，博物馆繁忙时通常能节省时间。

english: to kick or throw a ball at a goal
primaryExample: The coach told me to shoot only when I had enough space to aim at the goal.
primaryTranslation: 教练让我只有在有足够空间瞄准球门时才射门。

english: to make a public statement about a plan, decision
primaryExample: The school will announce the results tomorrow, after the judges have checked all the final entries.
primaryTranslation: 评委检查完所有决赛作品后，学校明天将公布结果。

english: negative of 'if'
primaryExample: We will have lunch outside unless the weather changes, in which case we can use the kitchen.
primaryTranslation: 除非天气变化，否则我们就在外面吃午饭；天气变了可用厨房。

english: making your own decisions; not controlled by others
primaryExample: She became more independent after moving away from home, although she still called her parents regularly.
primaryTranslation: 离家生活后她变得更独立了，但仍经常给父母打电话。

english: to say something is good and deserves to be chosen
primaryExample: Could you recommend a quiet restaurant where we can talk comfortably without having to raise our voices?
primaryTranslation: 你能推荐一家安静的餐厅，让我们不用提高声音就能自在聊天吗？

english: to ask people a question about a particular topic
primaryExample: The council plans to survey local residents before deciding whether the park needs a larger playground.
primaryTranslation: 市议会计划先调查当地居民，再决定公园是否需要更大的游乐场。

english: amount that is more than half of a group
primaryExample: The majority of students chose the earlier train because it would give them more time in the city.
primaryTranslation: 大多数学生选了较早的火车，这样在城里能多待一会儿。

english: long thin piece of wood from a tree
primaryExample: He used a long stick to pull the branch closer without damaging the young leaves underneath.
primaryTranslation: 他用长棍拉近树枝，没有损伤下面的嫩叶。

english: to ask for something
primaryExample: Guests should request an extra blanket at reception if their room feels cold during the night.
primaryTranslation: 夜间觉得房间冷的住客，可以到前台要求加一条毯子。

english: having a lot of money, possessions, or resources
primaryExample: The town became rich through trade, although many of its old warehouses are now used as galleries.
primaryTranslation: 这座城镇因贸易而富裕，如今许多旧仓库已改为画廊。

english: natural movement of outside air as part of the weather
primaryExample: A strong wind made it difficult to cycle home, especially along the open road near the fields.
primaryTranslation: 强风让骑车回家变得困难，尤其是经过田边开阔路段时。

english: not one of a group; not at all or in no way
primaryExample: We checked several possible routes, but none offered a direct connection to the village we wanted to visit.
primaryTranslation: 我们查了几条路线，但没有一条能直达想去的村庄。

english: to give things of similar value to each other
primaryExample: At the end of the lesson, students exchange their work so they can learn from each other's suggestions.
primaryTranslation: 课结束时，学生交换作业，从彼此的建议中学习。

english: amount of money planned to be spent on something
primaryExample: We stayed within our budget by cooking some meals ourselves instead of eating in restaurants every evening.
primaryTranslation: 我们自己做了几顿饭，没有每晚去餐厅，因此支出未超预算。

english: widely known; recognized by many people
primaryExample: The village is famous for its pottery, which local families have produced using traditional methods for centuries.
primaryTranslation: 这个村庄以陶器闻名，当地家庭数百年来一直沿用传统方法制作。

english: red liquid in the bodies of people and animals
primaryExample: The nurse checked the blood sample carefully before sending it to the laboratory for further tests.
primaryTranslation: 护士仔细检查血样，再送往实验室进一步检测。

english: right or suitable for some situation or purpose
primaryExample: Please wear shoes appropriate for walking, since part of the route follows a narrow path through the forest.
primaryTranslation: 请穿适合步行的鞋，因为部分路线要经过林间狭窄小路。

english: to stop from going forward or making progress
primaryExample: A fallen tree began to block the road, so drivers had to wait until workers removed it.
primaryTranslation: 倒下的树挡住了道路，司机们只好等工人清理。

english: slightly hot; not very hot
primaryExample: The room remained warm throughout the evening, even after we turned the heating down before dinner.
primaryTranslation: 晚饭前我们调低暖气后，房间整个晚上仍然暖和。

english: to add things together to find the total number
primaryExample: Please count the chairs before the guests arrive, so we can borrow more if there are not enough.
primaryTranslation: 客人到达前请清点椅子，不够的话我们还能再借。

english: part of an act in a play
primaryExample: The final scene takes place in a railway station, where the two friends unexpectedly meet again.
primaryTranslation: 最后一幕发生在火车站，两位朋友在那里意外重逢。

english: professional who writes books, articles, etc.
primaryExample: The writer spent months researching the village before using its history as the background for her novel.
primaryTranslation: 这位作家花了几个月研究村庄，再把它的历史作为小说背景。

english: information in something (e.g., a book or computer program)
primaryExample: The teacher reviewed the content of the website before recommending it to students preparing for their exams.
primaryTranslation: 老师先检查网站内容，再推荐给备考学生。

english: to stop something from happening or existing
primaryExample: Regular checks can prevent small faults from causing serious problems when the equipment is used every day.
primaryTranslation: 定期检查能防止设备日常使用中的小故障引发严重问题。

english: being out of danger
primaryExample: The guide found a safe place to stop, where everyone could rest away from the busy road.
primaryTranslation: 向导找到安全的停车处，让大家远离繁忙道路休息。

english: to ask someone to go somewhere or do something
primaryExample: We decided to invite our neighbours to dinner so that we could get to know them better.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定邀请邻居吃饭，以便更好地了解他们。

english: to combine two or more things to make one
primaryExample: Mix the ingredients slowly until the mixture becomes smooth, then pour it into the prepared baking dish.
primaryTranslation: 慢慢混合原料至顺滑，再倒入准备好的烤盘。

english: essential or particular part of something
primaryExample: Trust is an essential element of teamwork, especially when people must make decisions without consulting each other.
primaryTranslation: 信任是团队合作的重要要素，尤其是在成员无法相互商量就必须决策时。

english: working efficiently to produce a desired result
primaryExample: The new method proved effective because students remembered the vocabulary even several weeks after practising it.
primaryTranslation: 新方法很有效，因为学生在练习几周后仍记得词汇。

english: true or accurate
primaryExample: Before sending the report, check that every name is correct and that the dates match the records.
primaryTranslation: 发报告前，检查每个姓名是否正确，以及日期是否与记录一致。

english: of or relating to physical health or medicine
primaryExample: The centre provides medical care to families who would otherwise have to travel a long distance.
primaryTranslation: 该中心为家庭提供医疗服务，否则他们得长途奔波求医。

english: to agree that you did something bad, or that something bad is true
primaryExample: He was willing to admit that he had misunderstood the instructions before asking for another chance.
primaryTranslation: 他先承认自己误解了说明，然后请求再给一次机会。

english: 1) (n) sound made when you (v) hit something many times; 2) to win against another person or team
primaryExample: Our team managed to beat the visitors, although we were losing by two goals at half-time.
primaryTranslation: 虽然半场时落后两球，我们的队伍最后还是击败了客队。

english: machine used to talk to someone who is far away
primaryExample: The telephone in the entrance hall rang while we were helping our guests find their rooms.
primaryTranslation: 我们帮客人找房间时，门厅里的电话响了。

english: to make something that looks the same as the original
primaryExample: You can copy the instructions into your notebook, but please keep the original document on the desk.
primaryTranslation: 你可以把说明抄进笔记本，但请把原件留在桌上。

english: group of people who do or decide something
primaryExample: The committee postponed its decision until every member had received the revised proposal and enough time to consider it.
primaryTranslation: 委员会推迟了决定，直到每位成员收到修订提案并有足够时间考虑。

english: knowing or feeling that something exists
primaryExample: We were aware of the problem, but we had not realised how seriously it affected nearby residents.
primaryTranslation: 我们知道这个问题，但没意识到它对附近居民的影响有多严重。

english: suggestion about what someone should do
primaryExample: She followed her teacher's advice and practised speaking regularly instead of simply reading the same notes repeatedly.
primaryTranslation: 她听从老师建议，经常练习口语，而不是反复读同样的笔记。

english: to have the ability to cope with or take responsibility for
primaryExample: The manager showed us how to handle complaints calmly, even when customers were upset about a delay.
primaryTranslation: 经理教我们如何冷静处理投诉，即使顾客因延误而不满。

english: hard transparent material used for making windows
primaryExample: The door was made of thick glass, which allowed light into the room while keeping the noise outside.
primaryTranslation: 门用厚玻璃制成，既让光线进入房间，又隔绝外面的噪声。

english: an event to determine the quality of something or someone
primaryExample: During the trial, volunteers tested the new device and explained which features they found useful in daily life.
primaryTranslation: 试用期间，志愿者测试新设备，并说明哪些功能在日常生活中实用。

english: to be in a state of mental tension due to problems
primaryExample: Try not to stress about every small mistake, because learning a skill always involves some unsuccessful attempts.
primaryTranslation: 别为每个小错误感到紧张，因为学习技能总要经历一些失败尝试。

english: system for sending and receiving signals through the air
primaryExample: We listened to the weather report on the radio before deciding whether to continue our walk along the coast.
primaryTranslation: 决定是否继续沿海散步前，我们收听了广播天气预报。

english: the work of running something (e.g., a business)
primaryExample: The school improved its administration by introducing a system that made it easier to organise lessons and contact families.
primaryTranslation: 学校引入了便于安排课程及联系家长的系统，改进了行政管理。

english: difficult, not easy to understand or explain
primaryExample: The instructions seemed complex at first, but the diagrams made each stage of the process easier to understand.
primaryTranslation: 说明起初似乎很复杂，但图示让每个步骤都更容易理解。

english: written part of a book or other work
primaryExample: Read the whole text before answering, because some details become clearer when you reach the final paragraph.
primaryTranslation: 回答前请读完整篇文章，因为有些细节到最后一段才更清楚。

english: set of facts surrounding a person or event
primaryExample: The meaning becomes clearer when you read the sentence in context rather than looking at each word separately.
primaryTranslation: 把句子放回语境阅读，而不是逐词孤立理解，意思就会更清楚。

english: to sit on and control a horse or vehicle
primaryExample: We learned to ride safely on quiet roads before joining the cycle route that leads through the city centre.
primaryTranslation: 我们先在安静路段学习安全骑行，再进入通往市中心的骑行路线。

english: from one place or person to another with nothing or no one between
primaryExample: Please send the information directly to the organiser, so it does not get delayed while passing through several people.
primaryTranslation: 请直接把信息发给组织者，避免经多人转交而耽搁。

english: having a lot of weight
primaryExample: The box was too heavy for one person, so we waited until a colleague could help carry it upstairs.
primaryTranslation: 箱子太重，一个人搬不动，我们等同事来帮忙抬上楼。

english: to move, erase or take away from a place
primaryExample: Please remove your shoes before entering the room, since the wooden floor has only just been cleaned.
primaryTranslation: 请脱鞋后再进房间，因为木地板刚刚打扫干净。

english: to direct, lead or guide something
primaryExample: The guide will conduct the tour in English, although printed information is available in several other languages.
primaryTranslation: 向导将用英语带领参观，另有多种语言的印刷资料可取。

english: tools or materials used to perform a task
primaryExample: Check that all the equipment works properly before the visitors arrive, especially the microphone at the front.
primaryTranslation: 客人到达前，检查所有设备是否正常，特别是前面的麦克风。

english: indicates that there will be a bad result if something is done, not done, or done improperly
primaryExample: Please save your work before closing the program; otherwise, you may lose changes that have not been stored.
primaryTranslation: 关闭程序前请保存工作，否则可能丢失尚未保存的修改。

english: name given to something to identify or describe it
primaryExample: The title caught my attention, but it was the opening paragraph that persuaded me to read the whole article.
primaryTranslation: 标题引起我的注意，但真正让我读完整篇文章的是开头一段。

english: more than necessary; additional
primaryExample: We brought an extra blanket because the forecast suggested that the temperature might fall sharply during the night.
primaryTranslation: 我们多带了一条毯子，因为天气预报说夜间可能大幅降温。

english: a senior manager in a business or organization
primaryExample: The executive listened to employees' concerns before explaining why the company had decided to change its working hours.
primaryTranslation: 高管先倾听员工顾虑，再解释公司调整工作时间的原因。

english: a piece of furniture you sit on when sitting at a table or desk
primaryExample: She placed a chair beside the window so her grandfather could read comfortably in the afternoon sunlight.
primaryTranslation: 她在窗边放了把椅子，让祖父能舒适地借午后的阳光读书。

english: costing a lot of money
primaryExample: The hotel was more expensive than we expected, although breakfast and transport to the station were included.
primaryTranslation: 旅馆比预期贵，不过包含早餐和往返车站的交通。

english: to try something to see if you like it (e.g., food)
primaryExample: Visitors can sample the local cheese before deciding which varieties they would like to buy and take home.
primaryTranslation: 游客可以先尝当地奶酪，再决定购买哪些品种带回家。

english: state of being male or female mostly biological
primaryExample: The researchers recorded each bird's sex and age before releasing it safely back into its natural surroundings.
primaryTranslation: 研究人员记录每只鸟的性别和年龄后，将其安全放归自然。

english: to take something to a person or place
primaryExample: The shop promised to deliver the furniture on Saturday, when we would both be at home to receive it.
primaryTranslation: 商店答应星期六送家具，那天我们两人都在家收货。

english: recording capturing action with sound
primaryExample: The video shows how to replace the battery, with close-up views that make the smaller parts easier to identify.
primaryTranslation: 视频演示如何更换电池，特写画面让小零件更容易辨认。

english: something that joins things together; being joined
primaryExample: We checked the connection between the two cables before switching the machine on again to test the repair.
primaryTranslation: 再次开机测试维修效果之前，我们检查了两根电缆之间的连接。

english: most important, most basic or essential
primaryExample: Our primary concern is safety, so the trip will be postponed if the weather makes the route dangerous.
primaryTranslation: 我们最关心安全，如果天气使路线变得危险，就会推迟行程。

english: whether it is raining, sunny, cold, etc., outside
primaryExample: The weather improved during the afternoon, allowing us to finish the walk we had abandoned earlier that morning.
primaryTranslation: 下午天气转好，我们得以完成早晨放弃的徒步路线。

english: to gather things/people together in one place
primaryExample: Please collect the completed forms after the lesson, so the teacher can check who needs extra help.
primaryTranslation: 下课后请收齐填好的表格，以便老师查看谁需要额外帮助。

english: to give information or facts about something
primaryExample: We will inform you of any changes as soon as we receive confirmation from the people organising the event.
primaryTranslation: 我们一收到活动组织者的确认，就会通知你任何变更。

english: strong belief that influences a person's actions; basic law or belief
primaryExample: She refused to accept the gift because it went against her principle of treating every customer in the same way.
primaryTranslation: 她拒绝收礼，因为这违背了她平等对待每位顾客的原则。

english: not having curves, bends, or angles
primaryExample: Draw a straight line between the two points, then measure its length using the ruler beside your notebook.
primaryTranslation: 在两点间画一条直线，再用笔记本旁的尺子量长度。

english: to request a judge or others change a decision
primaryExample: The family plans to appeal against the decision because they believe important evidence was not considered during the hearing.
primaryTranslation: 这家人计划对裁决提出上诉，因为他们认为听证时忽略了重要证据。

english: more than usual; to a great degree
primaryExample: The guide is highly experienced, which is reassuring when the route passes through areas that are difficult to navigate.
primaryTranslation: 向导经验丰富，在经过难以辨路的地区时，这让人安心。

english: (v) to have (n) a belief that someone or something is safe, good, and reliable
primaryExample: We trust the guide to choose a suitable route because she knows the local mountains better than anyone.
primaryTranslation: 我们信任向导会选择合适路线，因为她最了解当地山地。

english: producing feelings of enjoyment or delight
primaryExample: The concert was a wonderful experience, especially when the audience joined the final song without any encouragement.
primaryTranslation: 音乐会令人难忘，尤其是观众自发加入最后一首歌的时候。

english: level; even; without curves or bumps
primaryExample: Choose a flat surface for the experiment, otherwise the water may spill before you finish taking measurements.
primaryTranslation: 实验要选平整表面，否则测量还没完成，水就可能洒出来。

english: completely; totally; very
primaryExample: Make absolutely sure the door is locked before leaving, because nobody will return to the building until Monday.
primaryTranslation: 离开前务必确认门锁好，因为星期一前没人会回到楼里。

english: to move steadily and easily in a certain direction
primaryExample: Water can flow through the narrow channel even after heavy rain, provided that fallen leaves are cleared away.
primaryTranslation: 只要清掉落叶，即使大雨后，水也能流过狭窄水道。

english: treating all people the same way
primaryExample: A fair solution should consider everyone's needs rather than giving the largest group everything it has requested.
primaryTranslation: 公平的解决办法应考虑所有人的需求，而非完全满足人数最多的一方。

english: further or added
primaryExample: Additional information will be sent to participants once the organisers have confirmed the final location and starting time.
primaryTranslation: 组织者确定最终地点和开始时间后，会向参与者发送补充信息。

english: having the duty of dealing with something; being the cause or creator of something; behaving in a mature and reasonable manner
primaryExample: Each student is responsible for checking their own work before sharing it with a partner for further suggestions.
primaryTranslation: 每个学生都有责任先检查自己的作业，再交给同伴提出建议。

english: land used for growing crops or raising animals
primaryExample: The farm welcomes school groups who want to learn where their food comes from and how vegetables are grown.
primaryTranslation: 农场欢迎学校团体，了解食物来源以及蔬菜的种植方式。

english: group of similar things gathered as a hobby
primaryExample: Her collection of old maps helped us understand how much the city had changed over the last century.
primaryTranslation: 她收藏的旧地图帮助我们了解这座城市百年来的巨大变化。

english: to attach a picture, photograph, etc., onto a wall
primaryExample: We decided to hang the picture above the fireplace, where visitors could see it as soon as they entered.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定把画挂在壁炉上方，让来访者一进门就能看见。

english: being harmful, unwanted, or unhelpful
primaryExample: The report described the negative effects of noise on residents who lived close to the main road.
primaryTranslation: 报告描述了噪声对住在主干道附近居民的不良影响。

english: group of people who work together (e.g., play music)
primaryExample: The band played several new songs before returning to the older music that most of the audience knew.
primaryTranslation: 乐队先演奏几首新歌，再演奏大部分观众熟悉的老歌。

english: measured or considered in comparison to something else
primaryExample: The relative importance of each factor changes depending on whether the journey is made for work or pleasure.
primaryTranslation: 各因素的相对重要性，会随旅行是出差还是休闲而变化。

english: a journey to visit several places for pleasure
primaryExample: The tour includes a visit to the old harbour, where many of the original warehouses are still standing.
primaryTranslation: 这次游览包含旧港口，那里许多原来的仓库至今仍在。

english: other choices
primaryExample: Cycling is a useful alternative to driving, especially when the roads become crowded during the morning rush hour.
primaryTranslation: 骑车是开车之外的实用选择，尤其是在早高峰道路拥堵时。

english: programs and instructions used by a computer
primaryExample: The software automatically saves your work, so an unexpected interruption does not necessarily mean losing everything you have written.
primaryTranslation: 软件会自动保存，因此意外中断不一定会丢失你写的所有内容。

english: two of the same thing (e.g., socks)
primaryExample: She packed a spare pair of shoes in case the ones she wore became wet during the walk.
primaryTranslation: 她带了一双备用鞋，以防脚上的鞋在徒步时弄湿。

english: large boat
primaryExample: The ship reached the harbour later than expected because strong winds had slowed its journey along the coast.
primaryTranslation: 强风延缓了沿海航行，轮船比预计更晚到港。

english: way you act, think, and feel about something
primaryExample: Her positive attitude encouraged the rest of the team when the project became more difficult than they had expected.
primaryTranslation: 项目难度超出预期时，她积极的态度鼓舞了其他队员。

english: not costing a lot of money
primaryExample: The tickets were surprisingly cheap because we booked early and agreed to travel outside the busiest hours.
primaryTranslation: 票价出奇地便宜，因为我们提前预订并避开了最繁忙时段。

english: two times the amount or degree; twice
primaryExample: The new room is double the size of our old office, so everyone has more space to work comfortably.
primaryTranslation: 新房间的面积是旧办公室的两倍，大家都有更宽敞舒适的工作空间。

english: part of the body from the thigh down
primaryExample: After a long day of walking, he stretched each leg carefully before sitting down to rest near the entrance.
primaryTranslation: 走了一整天后，他小心伸展双腿，才在入口附近坐下休息。

english: to watch carefully; to make a comment
primaryExample: Students were asked to observe the plants carefully and record any changes that appeared during the following week.
primaryTranslation: 学生要仔细观察植物，并记录接下来一周出现的变化。

english: set of spoken or written words that make a whole statement
primaryExample: Try to write a sentence that explains the idea clearly without using any of the words from the original text.
primaryTranslation: 试着不使用原文中的词，写一句清楚解释这个观点的话。

english: to make many copies of a page, magazine, or book
primaryExample: Please print a copy of the map, since we may not be able to use our phones in the valley.
primaryTranslation: 请打印一份地图，因为进了山谷后我们可能无法使用手机。

english: to move forward or toward a place or goal
primaryExample: Students progress at different speeds, so the teacher provides extra practice rather than expecting everyone to finish together.
primaryTranslation: 学生进步速度不同，因此老师提供额外练习，而非要求同时完成。

english: real facts about something
primaryExample: We wanted to know the truth about the delay before deciding whether to change our travel plans.
primaryTranslation: 我们想先弄清延误的真相，再决定是否调整旅行计划。

english: no person; no one; not any person
primaryExample: Nobody noticed that the window was open until a sudden gust of wind scattered the papers across the floor.
primaryTranslation: 直到一阵风把纸吹散到地板上，大家才发现窗户开着。

english: to look at someone or something very carefully in order to learn more
primaryExample: The engineer will examine the bridge carefully before deciding whether it is safe to open to traffic again.
primaryTranslation: 工程师会先仔细检查桥梁，再决定是否能安全恢复通车。

english: to put or set something down in a flat position
primaryExample: Please lay the clean towels on the bed before the guests arrive, so they can find everything easily.
primaryTranslation: 客人到达前请把干净毛巾平放在床上，方便他们找到用品。

english: quality of being fast or quick
primaryExample: We reduced our speed as we approached the village because children were playing close to the road.
primaryTranslation: 靠近村庄时我们减速了，因为孩子们正在路边玩耍。

english: activities influencing the policies of a government
primaryExample: She became interested in politics after learning how decisions made by the council affected services in her neighbourhood.
primaryTranslation: 了解市议会的决定如何影响社区服务后，她开始关注政治。

english: answer someone's question
primaryExample: His reply arrived just before lunch and included the information we needed to complete the booking form.
primaryTranslation: 他的回复在午饭前送达，包含了完成预订表所需的信息。

english: to put so they can be seen or be bought
primaryExample: The museum will display the photographs beside old maps, helping visitors understand how the town developed over time.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆将把照片与旧地图一起展出，帮助游客了解城镇发展。

english: to move something from one place to another
primaryExample: We need to transfer the files to another computer before the old machine is taken away for repairs.
primaryTranslation: 旧电脑送修之前，我们需要把文件转移到另一台电脑上。

english: so good it/they cannot be improved
primaryExample: The weather was perfect for walking, with enough sunshine to feel pleasant and a breeze to keep us cool.
primaryTranslation: 天气非常适合徒步，阳光温暖宜人，微风带来凉爽。

english: concerning a small quantity or degree
primaryExample: The room was slightly smaller than we expected, but its large windows made it feel bright and welcoming.
primaryTranslation: 房间比预期略小，但大窗户让它显得明亮舒适。

english: viewed as a whole; in general, not as details
primaryExample: The overall result was encouraging, although several small problems still needed attention before the project could continue.
primaryTranslation: 总体结果令人鼓舞，不过项目继续前仍需处理几个小问题。

english: to plan or want to do something
primaryExample: We intend to finish the repairs before winter, provided that the materials arrive within the next few weeks.
primaryTranslation: 只要材料在接下来几周内到达，我们打算在冬天前修好。

english: person that uses a service or thing (e.g., a website)
primaryExample: Each user can choose a different layout, so the program feels suitable for both beginners and experienced staff.
primaryTranslation: 每位用户都能选择不同布局，让程序同时适合初学者和熟练员工。

english: to say or write to answer the question
primaryExample: Please respond to the invitation by Friday, so the organisers know how many places they need to prepare.
primaryTranslation: 请在星期五前回复邀请，方便组织者确定需要准备多少座位。

english: main meal of the day, usually in the evening in the us
primaryExample: We invited our neighbours to dinner because we wanted an opportunity to talk without rushing between work and school.
primaryTranslation: 我们邀请邻居吃晚饭，希望有机会不受上下班接送的匆忙影响，好好聊天。

english: moving or happening without speed; not fast
primaryExample: The journey was slow because the road was narrow, but the views across the valley made it enjoyable.
primaryTranslation: 道路狭窄使行程缓慢，但山谷美景让旅途很愉快。

english: occurring or being done frequently
primaryExample: Regular practice helped her become more confident, even though she could only study for a short time each evening.
primaryTranslation: 尽管每晚只能学一小会儿，规律练习仍让她更有信心。

english: concerning the body of a person
primaryExample: The course combines physical exercise with teamwork, encouraging participants to communicate while they complete each activity together.
primaryTranslation: 课程结合体育锻炼与团队合作，鼓励参与者共同完成活动时沟通。

english: separated by an amount of time or space
primaryExample: The two villages are several kilometres apart, although a regular bus service makes it easy to travel between them.
primaryTranslation: 两村相距数公里，但定期公交让往返很方便。

english: to be appropriate for a given situation
primaryExample: The new timetable should suit people who work during the day, since most classes now begin in the evening.
primaryTranslation: 新课表应该适合白天工作的人，因为大多数课现在都在晚上开始。

english: system of government
primaryExample: The federal government announced a programme that would help smaller communities improve their roads and public transport.
primaryTranslation: 联邦政府宣布了一项计划，帮助小型社区改善道路和公共交通。

english: to make known, to show or prove
primaryExample: The old photographs reveal how much the harbour has changed since the town became a popular holiday destination.
primaryTranslation: 旧照片展示了自城镇成为热门度假地后，港口发生的巨大变化。

english: part of a whole divided into hundredths
primaryExample: The percentage of students walking to school increased after a safer crossing was built near the main entrance.
primaryTranslation: 主入口附近建了更安全的过街设施后，步行上学的学生比例增加了。

english: time when there is no war or fighting
primaryExample: After years of disagreement, people hoped the new agreement would bring lasting peace to both sides of the border.
primaryTranslation: 多年争端后，人们希望新协议为边境双方带来持久和平。

english: position or rank relative to others in a society
primaryExample: Her status within the organisation improved after she successfully led a project that other managers had considered too difficult.
primaryTranslation: 她成功领导了其他经理认为太难的项目后，组织内的地位提高了。

english: act that is against the law; murder, theft, etc.
primaryExample: The community organised a meeting to discuss how better lighting might reduce crime around the station after dark.
primaryTranslation: 社区开会讨论如何通过改善照明，减少车站周围夜间犯罪。

english: to not accept an invitation or offer; refuse
primaryExample: She decided to decline the invitation politely because she had already promised to help at another event.
primaryTranslation: 她决定礼貌谢绝邀请，因为已经答应去另一项活动帮忙。

english: period of 10 years
primaryExample: Over the past decade, the town has built several cycle paths that connect its residential areas with the centre.
primaryTranslation: 过去十年里，这座城镇建了几条连接住宅区与中心的自行车道。

english: to put a rocket into the air; put a ship into the water
primaryExample: The team will launch the research rocket tomorrow if the final safety checks are completed and the weather remains clear.
primaryTranslation: 如果最终安全检查完成且天气晴好，团队明天将发射科研火箭。

english: to tell someone about possible danger
primaryExample: The guide stopped to warn us about loose stones before we began walking down the steep mountain path.
primaryTranslation: 下陡峭山路前，向导停下来提醒我们小心松动的石头。

english: person who uses goods or services; individual buyer
primaryExample: Each consumer should be able to understand the total price before agreeing to buy a product or service.
primaryTranslation: 每位消费者在同意购买商品或服务前，都应能了解总价。

english: helpful act of kindness
primaryExample: Could you do me a favor and collect the parcel if it arrives while I am at work?
primaryTranslation: 如果包裹在我上班时送到，你能帮我收一下吗？

english: without water; not wet
primaryExample: Make sure the paint is completely dry before putting the shelves back, otherwise the surface may be damaged.
primaryTranslation: 重新装上架子前，要确保油漆全干，否则表面可能受损。

english: someone you have a business or personal relationship with
primaryExample: She discussed the new contract with her business partner before deciding whether the company could afford the extra staff.
primaryTranslation: 她先与商业伙伴讨论新合同，再决定公司能否承担增加员工的费用。

english: organization created for a particular cause or purpose
primaryExample: The institution provides training for adults who want to return to education after several years away from the classroom.
primaryTranslation: 这家机构为离开课堂多年后希望重返教育的成年人提供培训。

english: a particular area that is different from the area around it; (v) to see someone or something
primaryExample: We found a quiet spot beside the river where we could eat lunch without disturbing the people fishing nearby.
primaryTranslation: 我们在河边找到安静的地方吃午饭，不会打扰附近钓鱼的人。

english: large animal with 4 legs used for riding
primaryExample: The horse remained calm while the instructor showed us how to approach it without making sudden movements.
primaryTranslation: 教练教我们如何缓缓靠近时，马一直很平静。

english: finally
primaryExample: After trying several different methods, we eventually found a solution that worked without requiring any additional equipment.
primaryTranslation: 尝试几种方法后，我们终于找到了无需额外设备就能奏效的办法。

english: to make hot or hotter
primaryExample: Heat the soup gently while stirring, so it becomes warm throughout without sticking to the bottom of the pan.
primaryTranslation: 一边搅拌一边轻轻加热汤，让它均匀变热而不粘锅底。

english: to make someone feel happy, interested, or eager
primaryExample: The chance to work with real scientists can excite students who have only studied the subject in textbooks.
primaryTranslation: 与真正科学家合作的机会，能让只在课本里学过这门课的学生兴奋。

english: person who reads written or printed materials
primaryExample: The writer gives the reader enough information to understand the problem without revealing how the story will end.
primaryTranslation: 作者给读者足够的信息理解问题，却不透露故事结局。

english: being important; having a big effect on
primaryExample: The teacher explained the importance of checking sources before students began researching their projects on the internet.
primaryTranslation: 学生开始上网研究课题前，老师解释了核查来源的重要性。

english: amount of space between two things
primaryExample: We underestimated the distance between the two villages, so the walk took much longer than we had planned.
primaryTranslation: 我们低估了两村的距离，所以步行时间远超原计划。

english: to lead people visiting a new or unknown place
primaryExample: A local volunteer will guide us through the old neighbourhood and explain how its buildings have changed over time.
primaryTranslation: 当地志愿者会带我们走过老街区，讲解建筑随时间发生的变化。

english: to give or let someone do what they want
primaryExample: The council agreed to grant permission for the event, provided that the organisers kept the noise within reasonable limits.
primaryTranslation: 市议会同意批准活动，条件是组织者把噪声控制在合理范围内。

english: car that transports people for money
primaryExample: We booked a taxi for the early flight because no buses would reach the airport before our departure.
primaryTranslation: 我们为早班飞机预约出租车，因为起飞前没有公交车能到机场。

english: to give food (e.g., to an animal or a baby)
primaryExample: Please feed the cat before leaving, and check that there is enough fresh water in the bowl.
primaryTranslation: 离开前请喂猫，并检查碗里是否有足够的新鲜水。

english: strong feeling of hurt or discomfort
primaryExample: The pain in his shoulder gradually eased, allowing him to carry a small bag without feeling uncomfortable.
primaryTranslation: 肩膀的疼痛逐渐减轻，他能提小包而不觉得难受了。

english: area that includes certain kinds of job
primaryExample: The tourism sector provides many local jobs, although employment tends to fall when the summer season ends.
primaryTranslation: 旅游业为当地提供很多岗位，但夏季结束时就业通常减少。

english: something done wrong, calculated wrong.; error
primaryExample: She noticed a mistake in the address just before sending the package, which prevented a much longer delay.
primaryTranslation: 她寄包裹前发现地址有误，从而避免了更长时间的耽搁。

english: to make something sure, certain, or safe
primaryExample: Please check the list carefully to ensure that every participant receives the information before the meeting begins.
primaryTranslation: 请仔细核对名单，确保每位参与者会前都收到信息。

english: to be happy because you met your expectation
primaryExample: The new design should satisfy customers who want a lighter bag without giving up the space they need.
primaryTranslation: 新设计应能满足希望包更轻、又不愿减少容量的顾客。

english: most important one
primaryExample: Our chief concern was whether the children would have a safe place to wait until their parents arrived.
primaryTranslation: 我们最关心的是孩子们能否在安全的地方等父母来。

english: almost cold; not warm or hot
primaryExample: The air felt cool after sunset, so we put on our jackets before continuing along the river.
primaryTranslation: 日落后空气有些凉，我们穿上外套才继续沿河走。

english: skillful person with special knowledge
primaryExample: We asked an expert to examine the painting because its age and possible value were difficult to judge.
primaryTranslation: 画的年代和可能价值很难判断，因此我们请专家检查。

english: to move your hand or arm to say hello or goodbye
primaryExample: She turned to wave at her friends before the train moved slowly away from the crowded platform.
primaryTranslation: 火车缓缓驶离拥挤站台前，她转身向朋友们挥手。

english: direction to your right when facing the rising sun; opposite of north
primaryExample: The south of the country attracts many visitors, especially when the warmer weather makes its beaches pleasant in spring.
primaryTranslation: 这个国家的南部吸引许多游客，尤其是在春季天气转暖、海滩宜人时。

english: to work hard (often physically) for many hours
primaryExample: Workers had to labor for hours in the heat before the damaged road was finally safe to use again.
primaryTranslation: 工人们在炎热中辛苦劳作数小时，受损道路才终于恢复安全。

english: of the top layer; superficial
primaryExample: The first inspection found only surface damage, but a specialist still needed to check the machine's internal parts.
primaryTranslation: 初次检查仅发现表面损伤，但仍需专家检查机器内部零件。

english: place where books and other media are kept
primaryExample: The library stays open late during the week so people can borrow books after finishing work or school.
primaryTranslation: 图书馆平日开放到很晚，方便人们下班或放学后借书。

english: extremely good
primaryExample: The course received excellent reviews because the instructors explained difficult ideas clearly and gave everyone useful feedback.
primaryTranslation: 课程评价极佳，因为教师讲解清楚，并给每人有用的反馈。

english: boundary of a surface
primaryExample: We stayed away from the edge of the path because the ground had become slippery after the rain.
primaryTranslation: 雨后地面湿滑，所以我们远离小路边缘。

english: place where people live for a short time in tents
primaryExample: We reached the camp before sunset, leaving enough time to put up our tents and prepare a simple meal.
primaryTranslation: 我们日落前到达营地，有足够时间搭帐篷并准备简餐。

english: group of people listening, watch a play, movie, etc.
primaryExample: The speaker paused to let the audience consider the question before asking for suggestions from people near the front.
primaryTranslation: 演讲者停下来让听众思考问题，再请前排观众提出建议。

english: to move something to higher position
primaryExample: Please lift the box from both sides, since the bottom is weak and might break if you pull it.
primaryTranslation: 请从两边抬箱子，因为底部不牢，拉扯时可能破裂。

english: usual or standard way in which something is done
primaryExample: Follow the same procedure each time you use the equipment, even when you feel confident that everything is working.
primaryTranslation: 每次使用设备都要遵循同样程序，即使你确信一切正常。

english: a system for sending messages electronically, especially from one computer to another using the internet
primaryExample: I sent an e-mail to confirm our booking because the details on the website were not completely clear.
primaryTranslation: 我发了封电子邮件确认预订，因为网站上的细节不够清楚。

english: concerning, affecting, or involving the entire world
primaryExample: The exhibition explores global changes in transport and shows how local choices can affect people in other countries.
primaryTranslation: 展览探讨全球交通变化，并展示地方选择如何影响其他国家的人。

english: to try very hard to do something difficult
primaryExample: Many students struggle to speak confidently at first, even when they understand most of what their teacher says.
primaryTranslation: 许多学生起初很难自信开口，即使能听懂老师的大部分话。

english: to show how good a product is, to make people buy
primaryExample: The shop plans to advertise its new service online so that more people in nearby villages can discover it.
primaryTranslation: 商店计划上网宣传新服务，让附近村庄更多人知道。

english: to choose from a group, something most suitable
primaryExample: Please select a time that suits your whole group, since the guide cannot change the booking once it is confirmed.
primaryTranslation: 请选择适合全组的时间，因为确认后向导无法更改预订。

english: to be on every side of something
primaryExample: Tall trees surround the house, keeping the garden cool even when the afternoon sun becomes quite strong.
primaryTranslation: 高树环绕房屋，即使午后阳光很强，花园仍很凉爽。

english: range or space included in something
primaryExample: We could not understand the full extent of the problem until we spoke to families living near the river.
primaryTranslation: 与河边家庭交谈后，我们才理解问题的全部程度。

english: flowing water that runs from mountains to the sea
primaryExample: The river passes through several small towns before reaching the coast, where it becomes much wider and deeper.
primaryTranslation: 河流经过几个小镇后到达海岸，那里河道宽得多，也深得多。

english: happening once a year, or every year
primaryExample: The annual festival brings visitors to the town, giving local artists a chance to display and sell their work.
primaryTranslation: 每年的节庆吸引游客来到镇上，让本地艺术家有机会展示和销售作品。

english: completely or entirely
primaryExample: We did not fully understand the instructions until the teacher demonstrated the first stage of the experiment.
primaryTranslation: 直到老师演示实验第一步，我们才完全理解说明。

english: (v) to show (n) clear and obvious differences between two or more people or things
primaryExample: The article will contrast city life with village life, showing the advantages and difficulties that each can offer.
primaryTranslation: 文章将对比城市和乡村生活，展示各自的优点与困难。

english: to move along a surface by turning many times
primaryExample: We watched the ball roll down the slope until it stopped against a tree at the bottom.
primaryTranslation: 我们看球滚下斜坡，直到它在坡底一棵树旁停住。

english: what is true, as opposed to what is imagined
primaryExample: The reality of working abroad was more challenging than she expected, although she soon began to enjoy the experience.
primaryTranslation: 在国外工作的现实比她预期更难，不过她很快开始享受这段经历。

english: a picture made with a camera that shows how things look in real life
primaryExample: The photograph shows the square before the new station was built, when cars could still park beside the fountain.
primaryTranslation: 照片展示了新车站建成前的广场，那时汽车还能停在喷泉旁。

english: a person who is skilled and creative in art, such as a painter
primaryExample: The artist uses objects that people usually throw away to create pictures of places she remembers from childhood.
primaryTranslation: 这位艺术家用人们常丢弃的物品，创作她记忆中童年地方的图画。

english: to have opposite ideas; to disagree; to not match
primaryExample: The two accounts conflict with each other, so we need more evidence before deciding what actually happened.
primaryTranslation: 两份叙述相互矛盾，所以需要更多证据才能判断实际发生了什么。

english: complete or full; with no part left out; whole
primaryExample: The entire village helped prepare for the festival, from decorating the square to arranging places for visitors to stay.
primaryTranslation: 全村人都帮忙筹备节庆，从装饰广场到安排游客住宿。

english: fact that someone or something is in a particular place
primaryExample: Her presence at the meeting helped the new staff feel comfortable enough to ask questions they had been avoiding.
primaryTranslation: 她出席会议，让新员工放松下来，愿意问出一直回避的问题。

english: large group of people together in one place
primaryExample: A crowd gathered outside the theatre after the show, hoping to catch a glimpse of the main actor.
primaryTranslation: 演出结束后，人群聚在剧院外，希望看一眼主角。

english: place where two or three sides, lines, or roads meet
primaryExample: There is a small café on the corner where we usually meet before walking to the evening class together.
primaryTranslation: 拐角处有家小咖啡馆，我们通常在那里会合再一起去上夜课。

english: elements in our air, like oxygen or nitrogen
primaryExample: The teacher explained that this gas has no colour, so it cannot be identified simply by looking at it.
primaryTranslation: 老师解释说这种气体没有颜色，单凭观察无法辨认。

english: to change in position or direction
primaryExample: We need to shift our attention towards the most urgent tasks before spending time on smaller details.
primaryTranslation: 我们需要先把注意力转向紧急任务，再花时间处理细节。

english: material made of string, chain, or wire connected together at certain points
primaryExample: The gardener placed a net over the young plants to stop birds from eating the seeds before they grew.
primaryTranslation: 园丁给幼苗罩上网，防止种子发芽前被鸟吃掉。

english: groups of things that are similar in some way
primaryExample: Each book belongs to a different category, making it easier for visitors to find something that matches their interests.
primaryTranslation: 每本书按类别归置，方便游客找到符合兴趣的读物。

english: an employee who does general office work for another person in the office
primaryExample: The secretary checked everyone's availability before arranging a meeting that would give the manager enough time to discuss the proposal.
primaryTranslation: 秘书先确认大家的空闲时间，再安排会议，让经理有充足时间讨论提议。

english: process of protecting something from attack
primaryExample: The castle's walls were built for defense, although today visitors admire them mainly for their size and history.
primaryTranslation: 城墙原为防御而建，如今游客主要欣赏其规模与历史。

english: using very little time; moving far in little time
primaryExample: We made a quick decision because the last train was about to leave and there was no time to discuss alternatives.
primaryTranslation: 末班火车即将开走，没时间商量其他方案，我们迅速做了决定。

english: to heat food until it is ready to eat
primaryExample: We decided to cook together instead of going out, since everyone had brought something from the local market.
primaryTranslation: 大家都从当地市场带了食材，因此我们决定一起做饭而不外出吃。

english: to place something over or cover a large area
primaryExample: Spread the mixture evenly across the surface so that every part of the cake receives the same thin layer.
primaryTranslation: 把混合物均匀铺在表面，让蛋糕每个部分都覆盖同样薄的一层。

english: concerning or involving the center of an atom
primaryExample: The museum explains how nuclear energy is produced and encourages visitors to consider both its benefits and its challenges.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆解释核能的产生方式，并鼓励游客考虑其优点与挑战。

english: a device that is used to weigh a person or thing
primaryExample: The scale showed that the package was heavier than expected, so we removed a few items before posting it.
primaryTranslation: 秤显示包裹比预期重，我们寄出前取走了几件东西。

english: someone who operates a vehicle
primaryExample: The driver waited until everyone had fastened their seat belts before carefully pulling away from the busy station.
primaryTranslation: 司机等所有人系好安全带，才小心驶离繁忙车站。

english: small round object often used in a game or sport
primaryExample: The ball landed behind the fence, so the children asked their neighbour if they could collect it from her garden.
primaryTranslation: 球落到围栏后，孩子们便问邻居能否去她花园捡球。

english: to produce tears and sounds because of pain
primaryExample: The little boy began to cry when he lost sight of his family in the busy market.
primaryTranslation: 小男孩在热闹的市场里看不见家人时，开始哭起来。

english: making someone known to another by name
primaryExample: After a brief introduction, the guide asked us to share what we already knew about the history of the town.
primaryTranslation: 简短介绍之后，向导请我们分享对这座城镇历史已有的了解。

english: something that is a necessity
primaryExample: A basic requirement of the course is that students attend regularly and complete a short project before the final lesson.
primaryTranslation: 课程基本要求是定期出席，并在最后一课前完成一个小项目。

english: direction to your left when facing the rising sun
primaryExample: The north of the country receives more rain, which explains why its valleys remain green throughout the summer.
primaryTranslation: 这个国家的北部降雨较多，因此那里的山谷整个夏天都保持青绿。

english: to provide evidence to establish the truth of
primaryExample: Please confirm your arrival time tomorrow, so we can arrange for someone to meet you at the station.
primaryTranslation: 请明天确认抵达时间，方便我们安排人在车站接你。

english: having higher status or authority than another person
primaryExample: A senior member of staff will review the proposal before it is passed to the people responsible for the budget.
primaryTranslation: 提案交给预算负责人前，会先由一位资深员工审阅。

english: short for photograph; a picture taken by a camera
primaryExample: The photo was taken from the top of the hill, where the whole village could be seen below.
primaryTranslation: 照片是在山顶拍的，从那里能俯瞰整个村庄。

english: to say that you will not accept something
primaryExample: She did not refuse the offer immediately, but asked for time to consider how it would affect her family.
primaryTranslation: 她没有立即拒绝邀请，而是要求时间考虑对家人的影响。

english: to carry things from one place to another
primaryExample: The company uses smaller vehicles to transport goods through streets that are too narrow for its larger trucks.
primaryTranslation: 公司用小型车辆把货物运过大卡车无法通过的窄街。

english: to rise or appear out of some background
primaryExample: As the fog began to clear, the roofs of several houses started to emerge from the grey background.
primaryTranslation: 雾渐渐散开，几栋房子的屋顶开始从灰色背景中显现。

english: picture showing the geography of an area
primaryExample: We checked the map before leaving the main road, because the smaller paths were not clearly marked on the ground.
primaryTranslation: 我们离开主路前查看了地图，因为地面上的小路标记不清。

english: abstract idea of something or how it works
primaryExample: The teacher used a simple experiment to explain a concept that had seemed confusing when we read about it.
primaryTranslation: 这个概念在阅读时显得难懂，老师便用简单实验讲解。

english: area of land that is surrounded by water
primaryExample: The island can only be reached by boat, which makes planning around the weather an important part of any visit.
primaryTranslation: 这座岛只能乘船到达，因此每次参观都必须考虑天气安排。

english: to improve society by removing abuse and injustices
primaryExample: The new measures aim to reform the system so that people receive support according to their needs rather than their connections.
primaryTranslation: 新措施旨在改革制度，让人们按需求而非关系得到支持。

english: not one or the other; not either; none of two things
primaryExample: Neither route is particularly difficult, although the path beside the river offers more shade on a hot afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 两条路线都不算难走，不过河边小路在炎热午后更遮阴。

english: sport where 2 teams try to kick a ball in a goal; soccer
primaryExample: We watched the football match together, even though most of us supported different teams during the rest of the season.
primaryTranslation: 我们一起看了这场足球赛，尽管赛季其他时候大多支持不同球队。

english: to continue to live despite illness or trouble
primaryExample: The young trees managed to survive the dry summer because volunteers brought water to the park every evening.
primaryTranslation: 幼树熬过了干旱的夏天，因为志愿者每晚都给公园送水。

english: act of flying
primaryExample: Our flight arrived early, but we still had to wait for the bus that would take us into the city.
primaryTranslation: 飞机提前到达，但我们仍要等进城的公交车。

english: side of your body your heart is on
primaryExample: The library is on your left after the bridge, opposite the building with the large blue door.
primaryTranslation: 过桥后图书馆在你的左边，就在蓝色大门的建筑对面。

english: to find a way to deal with a problem
primaryExample: Working together helped us solve a problem that none of us had been able to manage on our own.
primaryTranslation: 合作让我们解决了一个谁单独都解决不了的问题。

english: person who lives, or is near, you
primaryExample: Our neighbor offered to look after the plants while we were away, provided we showed her where everything was kept.
primaryTranslation: 邻居愿意在我们外出时照顾植物，只要我们告诉她用品的位置。

english: images, color, or information behind the main one
primaryExample: The mountains in the background made the photograph look dramatic, although the main subject was the small farmhouse.
primaryTranslation: 虽然照片主体是小农舍，背景中的群山让画面很有气势。

english: way of doing by using special knowledge or skill
primaryExample: The instructor demonstrated a breathing technique that helped the singers stay relaxed while holding longer notes together.
primaryTranslation: 导师演示了一种呼吸技巧，帮助歌手在合唱长音时保持放松。

english: amount of activity over a communication system
primaryExample: The website experienced heavy traffic after the announcement, so some users had to wait before the pages would load.
primaryTranslation: 公告后网站访问量很大，一些用户需要等待页面加载。

english: addition or change that makes something better
primaryExample: We noticed an improvement in her confidence after she started practising with a partner rather than studying entirely alone.
primaryTranslation: 她开始和伙伴练习、不再完全独自学习后，我们发现她更有信心了。

english: device used to make things (e.g., a hammer or driver)
primaryExample: The carpenter selected a smaller tool because the space around the damaged part was too narrow for his usual equipment.
primaryTranslation: 木匠选了较小的工具，因为损坏部位周围太窄，常用器具放不下。

english: outcome of an event; result
primaryExample: One unexpected consequence of the new bus route was that more visitors began shopping in the smaller villages.
primaryTranslation: 新公交路线带来的意外结果是，更多游客开始在小村庄购物。

english: condition or fact that affects a situation
primaryExample: The teacher considered each student's circumstances before deciding how much additional time they should receive for the project.
primaryTranslation: 老师先考虑每位学生的具体情况，再决定项目应给多少额外时间。

english: to breathe in through a cigarette and then blow it out
primaryExample: People are asked not to smoke near the entrance, where children often wait for their parents after lessons.
primaryTranslation: 请勿在入口附近吸烟，孩子们下课后经常在那里等父母。

english: feeling or action in response to something
primaryExample: Her reaction to the news surprised us, because we had expected her to be disappointed rather than excited.
primaryTranslation: 她对消息的反应让我们吃惊，因为我们原以为她会失望而非兴奋。

english: drops of water that fall out of clouds in the sky
primaryExample: The rain continued throughout the morning, so we explored the museum instead of walking along the coastal path.
primaryTranslation: 整个上午都在下雨，我们便参观博物馆而没有去海岸小路徒步。

english: working hard doing something; full of activity
primaryExample: The café becomes busy after school, when families stop for a drink before continuing their journey home.
primaryTranslation: 放学后咖啡馆变得忙碌，家庭们回家途中会在那里停下喝点东西。

english: a time or event where teaching and learning occur; class
primaryExample: The lesson ended with a short discussion in which students explained how they could use the new vocabulary outside class.
primaryTranslation: 课程以简短讨论结束，学生解释了如何在课外运用新词汇。

english: part of the head that thinks and controls your body
primaryExample: The exhibition explains how the brain processes information and why people sometimes remember the same event in different ways.
primaryTranslation: 展览解释大脑如何处理信息，以及为何人们对同一事件会有不同记忆。

english: a large amount of something, often of no particular shape
primaryExample: A mass of dark clouds appeared above the hills just as we were preparing to leave the village.
primaryTranslation: 我们正准备离开村庄时，山丘上方出现了一大片乌云。

english: causing laughter; amusing
primaryExample: The story was funny because the main character kept misunderstanding instructions that seemed perfectly clear to everyone else.
primaryTranslation: 故事很有趣，因为主角总误解那些别人看来十分清楚的说明。

english: give something of value to or help someone or something
primaryExample: Everyone can contribute ideas during the meeting, even if they have only recently joined the project team.
primaryTranslation: 每个人都可以在会上提出想法，即使刚加入项目组也一样。

english: act or result of not achieving your goals
primaryExample: The team treated the failure as a chance to learn rather than a reason to abandon the project entirely.
primaryTranslation: 团队把失败视为学习机会，而不是彻底放弃项目的理由。

english: to arrange a time to do something with others
primaryExample: We should schedule the meeting for the afternoon, when the colleagues arriving by train will have reached the office.
primaryTranslation: 会议应安排在下午，那时乘火车来的同事已经到办公室。

english: person who makes a speech before a group
primaryExample: The speaker invited questions from the audience after explaining how the local community had developed the new garden.
primaryTranslation: 演讲者介绍社区如何建成新花园后，邀请听众提问。

english: lowest part of something; part on which it rests
primaryExample: The instructions were printed at the bottom of the page, where several people had failed to notice them.
primaryTranslation: 说明印在页面底部，几个人都没有注意到。

english: to take on responsibility for something
primaryExample: The committee agreed to adopt the proposal after several changes made it easier for smaller organisations to participate.
primaryTranslation: 几项修改让小机构更容易参与后，委员会同意采纳提案。

english: to mix several things together to form one thing
primaryExample: The course will combine practical activities with discussion, so students can test ideas before explaining what they have learned.
primaryTranslation: 课程将结合实践与讨论，让学生先检验想法，再说明所学。

english: very high piece of land, higher than a hill
primaryExample: The mountain was partly hidden by clouds when we arrived, but its highest peak became visible later that afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 我们到达时山被云部分遮住，不过下午晚些时候最高峰显现了。

english: to use valuable things ineffectively
primaryExample: We did not want to waste the remaining time, so we divided the work and started immediately.
primaryTranslation: 我们不想浪费剩余时间，于是分工后立即开始。

english: to put a thing where it can't be found; go where you won't be found
primaryExample: The children tried to hide the gift behind the sofa until their grandmother arrived for her birthday dinner.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们想把礼物藏在沙发后，等祖母来吃生日晚餐。

english: formal relationship between a husband and a wife
primaryExample: Their marriage brought together two large families who had lived in neighbouring villages without knowing each other well.
primaryTranslation: 他们的婚姻连接了两个大家庭，双方虽住在邻村却原本不熟。

english: piece of paper that lets you enter or use something
primaryExample: Keep your ticket until the end of the journey, because someone may need to check it before you leave the station.
primaryTranslation: 请保留车票直到旅程结束，因为出站前可能还要检票。

english: food for eating at a particular time (e.g., dinner)
primaryExample: We shared a simple meal after the walk, enjoying the chance to talk about what we had seen.
primaryTranslation: 徒步后我们共享简餐，愉快地聊起沿途见闻。

english: someone who works with you; coworker
primaryExample: A colleague offered to check my report, pointing out several details that I had missed while working quickly.
primaryTranslation: 一位同事主动检查我的报告，指出了我赶工时遗漏的细节。

english: soft container to put things in and carry with you
primaryExample: She packed a small bag for the journey, choosing only things that she could carry comfortably throughout the day.
primaryTranslation: 她为旅程装了个小包，只选能整天轻松携带的东西。

english: to say something again
primaryExample: Could you repeat the final instruction slowly, so everyone understands what to do before the activity begins?
primaryTranslation: 你能慢慢重复最后一条说明，让大家在活动开始前明白怎么做吗？

english: same in shape, size, or number
primaryExample: The pieces should be equal in size, otherwise some will finish cooking before the larger ones are ready.
primaryTranslation: 各块大小要相等，否则小块会在大块熟之前就煮好。

english: act of making your thoughts and feelings known
primaryExample: The class encouraged expression through music and movement, allowing students to share feelings they found difficult to describe.
primaryTranslation: 课堂鼓励通过音乐和动作表达，让学生分享难以言说的感受。

english: with; showing one amount added to another
primaryExample: The price includes the main course plus a drink, but you will need to pay separately for dessert.
primaryTranslation: 价格包含主菜加一杯饮料，但甜点需要另付费。

english: in a way that is much more than usual or expected
primaryExample: The instructions were extremely helpful because they explained not only what to do but also why each step mattered.
primaryTranslation: 说明极其有帮助，因为不仅解释做什么，也说明各步骤的重要性。

english: person who owns or has something
primaryExample: The owner showed us around the house and explained which parts had belonged to the original building.
primaryTranslation: 房主带我们参观房屋，解释哪些部分属于最初的建筑。

english: an airplane
primaryExample: Our plane landed before sunrise, so the city was still dark when we began the journey to our hotel.
primaryTranslation: 飞机在日出前降落，因此前往旅馆时城市仍然漆黑。

english: radio or television advertisement
primaryExample: The commercial showed a family preparing dinner together, although the product itself appeared only briefly at the end.
primaryTranslation: 广告展现一家人一起做晚饭，产品本身却只在结尾短暂出现。

english: another way of saying 'woman'
primaryExample: The lady sitting beside me explained which stop was closest to the museum and where I could buy a ticket.
primaryTranslation: 坐在身旁的女士告诉我哪站离博物馆最近，以及哪里能买票。

english: work required by your job or position
primaryExample: It is my duty to check that everyone has left the building before I lock the main entrance.
primaryTranslation: 我有责任在锁上大门前确认所有人都已离开。

english: being strong
primaryExample: The bridge was tested for strength before traffic was allowed to use it again after the repairs.
primaryTranslation: 修复后重新通车之前，桥梁接受了强度测试。

english: to join or attach things together
primaryExample: The new path will connect the school to the park, giving children a safer route away from the road.
primaryTranslation: 新小路将连接学校与公园，让孩子远离公路，走更安全的路线。

english: of a particular society's customs and beliefs
primaryExample: The museum organises cultural events that introduce visitors to the music and stories of families living in the region.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆举办文化活动，介绍当地家庭的音乐和故事。

english: to put things into a particular order; to plan and organize an event
primaryExample: We will arrange the chairs in a circle so everyone can see each other during the discussion.
primaryTranslation: 我们会把椅子排成圆圈，让大家讨论时都能看见彼此。

english: often dishonest plan to get or do something
primaryExample: The scheme promised easy profits, but several people became suspicious when they were asked to pay large fees in advance.
primaryTranslation: 该计划承诺轻松获利，但预先索取大笔费用让几个人起疑。

english: amount of money that is paid for something
primaryExample: The payment must reach the office before Friday if you want your place on the course to be confirmed.
primaryTranslation: 要确认课程名额，付款必须在星期五前到达办公室。

english: in a way that is to be regretted; unluckily
primaryExample: Unfortunately, the museum was closed when we arrived, so we explored the nearby gardens instead of waiting outside.
primaryTranslation: 遗憾的是，到达时博物馆关门了，因此我们改去附近花园游览。

english: short; using few words
primaryExample: Please give a brief explanation of your idea before showing the pictures that illustrate how it would work.
primaryTranslation: 展示说明运作方式的图片之前，请先简要解释你的想法。

english: animal with feathers that uses wings to fly
primaryExample: A small bird landed on the fence while we were sitting quietly in the garden after lunch.
primaryTranslation: 午饭后我们静静坐在花园时，一只小鸟落在围栏上。

english: to show how something works (e.g., product)
primaryExample: The instructor will demonstrate how to use the equipment before allowing anyone to try the activity without assistance.
primaryTranslation: 教练会先演示器材用法，再允许大家独立尝试活动。

english: helping a cause by giving money, things, services
primaryExample: Her contribution to the project was important because she understood the concerns of people living near the proposed site.
primaryTranslation: 她了解拟建地点附近居民的顾虑，因此对项目的贡献很重要。

english: to be thankful for; to value or admire
primaryExample: We appreciate the time you have spent helping us, especially since you were already busy preparing your own presentation.
primaryTranslation: 我们很感激你花时间帮忙，尤其是你本来就在忙着准备自己的报告。

english: one of the main sections of a book
primaryExample: The final chapter explains how the characters' choices changed their lives, rather than simply telling us what happened next.
primaryTranslation: 最后一章说明人物选择如何改变生活，而非仅叙述后来的事。

english: something that you don't want others to know; private
primaryExample: They kept the plan secret until all the arrangements were complete, hoping to surprise their parents on the day.
primaryTranslation: 他们在安排妥当前一直保密，希望当天给父母一个惊喜。

english: according to what you heard; from what can be seen
primaryExample: Apparently, the earlier train has been cancelled, although we are still waiting for confirmation from the station staff.
primaryTranslation: 据说早一班火车取消了，不过我们仍在等车站工作人员确认。

english: written fiction story
primaryExample: The novel follows a family through several generations, showing how the same village changes as the years pass.
primaryTranslation: 小说讲述一个家族几代人的故事，展现同一村庄随岁月发生的变化。

english: organization of people or groups who have a similar interest or particular goal
primaryExample: The union represents workers from several local factories and meets regularly to discuss their concerns about working conditions.
primaryTranslation: 工会代表当地几家工厂的工人，定期讨论他们对工作条件的顾虑。

english: to destroy with fire
primaryExample: The old papers began to burn quickly, so he closed the stove door before any sparks could escape.
primaryTranslation: 旧纸很快燃烧起来，他在火星飞出前关上炉门。

english: general direction of developing, proceeding
primaryExample: The report identifies a growing trend towards working from home, although it notes that many jobs still require travel.
primaryTranslation: 报告指出居家工作趋势增强，不过也说明许多工作仍需出行。

english: existing or occurring at the beginning
primaryExample: Our initial plan was to visit three towns, but we later decided to spend more time exploring just one.
primaryTranslation: 最初计划游览三个城镇，但后来决定只深入探索其中一个。

english: feeling of happiness, enjoyment, or satisfaction
primaryExample: It was a pleasure to see the children enjoying the garden that volunteers had worked so hard to create.
primaryTranslation: 看到孩子们喜欢志愿者辛勤建成的花园，令人愉快。

english: idea about what someone should do
primaryExample: His suggestion was to leave earlier, which would give us enough time to stop for breakfast before the meeting.
primaryTranslation: 他建议早点出发，这样会前有足够时间停下来吃早餐。

english: being important or serious; vital; dangerous
primaryExample: Access to clean water is critical for the village, especially during the months when very little rain falls.
primaryTranslation: 洁净水源对村庄至关重要，尤其是在少雨的月份。

english: to bring people/animals together into a group
primaryExample: We will gather outside the main entrance before the guide takes us through the parts normally closed to visitors.
primaryTranslation: 我们将在主入口外集合，然后由向导带往通常不开放的区域。

english: in large part; mainly or chiefly
primaryExample: The audience consisted mostly of local families, although a few visitors had travelled from towns further along the coast.
primaryTranslation: 观众主要是当地家庭，也有少数游客来自更远的沿海城镇。

english: planet we live on
primaryExample: The exhibition shows how the earth has changed over time and explains why some landscapes continue to develop.
primaryTranslation: 展览展示地球如何随时间变化，并解释为何一些地貌仍在演变。

english: to cause something to open or burst suddenly
primaryExample: The children watched the bubbles pop as they rose above the garden and touched the branches of the trees.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们看着泡泡升到花园上方，碰到树枝后破裂。

english: extremely important and necessary
primaryExample: It is essential to check the weather before setting off, because conditions in the mountains can change very quickly.
primaryTranslation: 出发前查看天气至关重要，因为山里天气可能迅速变化。

english: to wish for, hope, or want something
primaryExample: People who desire a quieter life sometimes move to smaller towns, although they may miss the convenience of city services.
primaryTranslation: 想要安静生活的人有时搬去小镇，但可能怀念城市服务的便利。

english: to try to encourage the popularity and sales of a product
primaryExample: The town plans to promote local products through a weekend market where visitors can meet the people who make them.
primaryTranslation: 镇上计划通过周末市场推介本地产品，让游客与制作者见面。

english: happening or being in the present time
primaryExample: The library is currently being repaired, so readers must collect their books from a temporary room in the town hall.
primaryTranslation: 图书馆目前在维修，读者须到市政厅临时房间取书。

english: to pay a person to work for you; to give a job to
primaryExample: The business hopes to employ more local people once its new workshop is ready to begin producing furniture.
primaryTranslation: 新车间准备开始生产家具后，企业希望雇用更多当地人。

english: track made with stones/by walking over the ground
primaryExample: We followed a narrow path through the woods until the trees opened up and we could see the lake.
primaryTranslation: 我们沿着林间窄路前行，直到树林变疏，看见湖水。

english: matter people talk or write about
primaryExample: The topic attracted so much interest that the teacher agreed to continue discussing it during the following lesson.
primaryTranslation: 这个话题引起很大兴趣，老师同意下一节课继续讨论。

english: large area of sand, next to an area of water
